label.en: All organisms are made of cells

level1.en: Think about plants, animals and bacteria. What are they all made up of?

clue.en: However different they look, all living organisms are made up of the same basic building block.

level2Template.en: All living organisms are made up of one or more ___.

label.en: The cell is the basic unit of structure and function

level1.en: What does one cell stand for, in the structure and the working of a living thing?

clue.en: The cell is the smallest level at which both the structure and the working of life are found.

level2Template.en: The cell is the basic unit of structure and ___ in living beings.

label.en: New cells arise only from pre-existing cells

level1.en: Where do new cells come from? Can they form from non-living material?

clue.en: A new cell comes only from a cell that already exists, through cell division.

text.en: All living organisms are made up of one or more cells.
The cell is the basic unit of structure and function in living beings.
All cells arise from pre-existing cells.
